description: invalidSieve appears 4x across sieve.rs and sieve_integration.rs; sieveIsActive appears 2x. No shared constants. Also handle_sieve_validate builds invalidSieve via raw json!() not SetErrorType::custom(). Fix: define const SIEVE_ERR_INVALID and SIEVE_ERR_IS_ACTIVE in sieve.rs; use them everywhere including validate handler.
title: sieve_set: magic error strings should be named constants
